# bitbucket_branch_restriction (Resource)

A branch restriction rule on a Bitbucket Cloud repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_branch_restriction" "require_approvals" {
  repository_slug   = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  kind              = "require_approvals_to_merge"
  branch_match_kind = "glob"
  pattern           = "main"
  value             = 2
}

resource "bitbucket_branch_restriction" "no_force_push" {
  repository_slug   = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  kind              = "force"
  branch_match_kind = "glob"
  pattern           = "main"
}

# Block direct pushes to main except for the "release-managers" group.
resource "bitbucket_branch_restriction" "restrict_push" {
  repository_slug   = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  kind              = "push"
  branch_match_kind = "glob"
  pattern           = "main"
  groups            = ["release-managers"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Restriction type, e.g. "push", "delete", "force", "restrict_merges", "require_approvals_to_merge", "require_passing_builds_to_merge".
- `repository_slug` (String) Slug of the repository this restriction applies to.

### Optional

- `branch_match_kind` (String) "glob" (use pattern) or "branching_model". Defaults to "glob".
- `groups` (List of String) Slugs of the workspace groups this restriction applies to, e.g. which groups are allowed to push directly on a "push" kind restriction. Leave unset for restrictions that don't scope to specific groups.
- `pattern` (String) Branch name or glob pattern the restriction applies to, e.g. "main" or "release/*".
- `users` (List of String) UUIDs of the users this restriction applies to, e.g. who is allowed to push directly on a "push" kind restriction. Leave unset for restrictions that don't scope to specific users.
- `value` (Number) Numeric value for restrictions that need one, e.g. required approval count.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import/state identifier, formatted as "workspace/repository_slug/restriction_id".
- `restriction_id` (Number) Bitbucket-assigned ID of the restriction.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_branch_restriction.require_approvals payments-api/123456
```
